requirements.text: 12+ years of experience with data querying languages (e.g., SQL), scripting languages (e.g., Python or R), and statistical or mathematical software for large-scale data analysis
Experience developing and applying advanced statistical methods including predictive modeling, causal inference, experimentation design, and time series forecasting in a product context
Experience influencing product strategy and executive decision-making through data-driven narratives, written analytical frameworks, and stakeholder alignment across multiple cross-functional teams
Experience establishing analytical standards, data infrastructure best practices, or measurement frameworks adopted broadly across an organization or business domain
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
Experience defining and scaling self-service analytics platforms or data explorability tools that reduce time-to-insight for non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated use of AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows, including responsible validation of AI-generated outputs and adherence to ethical AI practices
Background in ambiguous and sparse data environments to operationalize e.g. harm prevalence measurement, causal inference, root-cause analysis– rooted in quantitative and statistical foundations
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Experience working in fast-paced, high-ambiguity, cross-functional environments – able to jump from agentic trace deep-dives to explaining risk dimensions in plain English to policy stakeholders
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
